scope: Isolated local QA only; no production connections or deployment

environment.php: 8.3.36, built-in HTTP server, 5 workers, OPcache enabled
environment.redis: 7.0.15, separate temporary loopback instance for synthetic viewers

changes: Share movie/series genre option pools and hydrate each dropdown when opened; keep saved values in every ordinary form submission
Count stream viewers with ZCARD instead of transferring every UUID; preserve detailed connection reads
Allow the update-channel note to wrap on narrow screens

paired_http_runs.routes: 10 pages, 7 tables, 3 table searches; 96 mixed requests each at concurrency 1/4/8/16/32
paired_http_runs.query_profiling_note: All queries were temporarily logged with long_query_time=0 during paired runs; Slow_queries counters here do not classify normal slow operations. Original logging settings restored.

redis_counter.method: 30 batched counts of 25 streams with 5000 synthetic viewer records; INFO overhead included in byte totals

mysql_review.notes: Repeated category queries eliminated. Stream listing GROUP BY still uses a temporary table; its query averaged about 4 ms in QA. No schema, index or database sizing changes applied.

regression_checks: 34 related PHPUnit tests / 210 assertions against isolated Redis and database fixtures
Real settings save, opened/unopened dropdowns and reset checked in headless Chrome
limits: Loopback measurements exclude Internet, TLS and production network latency
PHP built-in server is not a production Nginx/PHP-FPM capacity test
Synthetic viewer records do not represent actual video traffic or encoder load
Two minutes validates a short sustained load, not long-term endurance
Warm response times vary with workstation load; paired samples and a separate sustained run are reported
S3 remains unconfigured; no production release or deployment performed
